name: io.github.theluckystrike/measles-cases-by-state-outbreak-mcp
title: Measles Cases by State and Outbreak MCP
description: US measles cases by state, outbreak count, hospitalizations, weekly trend and MMR rates from CDC.

tools.name: measles_cases_us
tools.description: Confirmed US measles cases for this year (or 2025) from CDC: the total, the number of outbreaks and the share of cases that are outbreak-associated, jurisdictions with cases, cases by age, vaccination status, percent hospitalized, deaths, the previous year for comparison and the trend over the last complete weeks.

year.description: Year. Default the current year. Full breakdowns exist for this year and last year; earlier years give the total only.

tools.name: measles_cases_by_state
tools.description: Confirmed measles cases by state from CDC. With a state: its cases this year, last year and the year before, its rank, and its kindergarten MMR coverage. Without a state: every state ranked by cases this year and the states with none. New York City is reported separately from the rest of New York State; "NY" adds both.

state.description: State name or two-letter code, "New York City", "New York State" or "DC". Omit for all states.

year.description: Year, one of the last three. Default the current year.

top.description: How many states to list in the summary when no state is given. Default 15.

tools.name: measles_cases_history
tools.description: US measles case history from CDC. view yearly (default): confirmed cases per year from 1985 to this year, with the highest and lowest year in the range. view weekly: cases per week by rash onset for one year (2022 on), monthly totals, the peak week and the recent trend.

to_year.description: yearly: last year. Default the current year.

year.description: weekly: the year. Default the current year.

tools.name: mmr_vaccination_rates
tools.description: Kindergarten MMR vaccination coverage (2 doses) from CDC. With a state: its rate for the latest or a given school year, its rank, the change since 2019-20 and the trend. Without a state: every state ranked from lowest, how many are below the 95% herd immunity target, and the state median. School years 2009-10 to the latest.

state.description: State name or code, "New York City" or "Houston". Omit for all states.

school_year.description: School year such as 2025-26 (or 2025). Default the latest.
